meta.note: Regions and descriptions are official Rockstar text. Map geometry below is an original schematic for navigation only — NOT the official game map, not to scale, no coordinates claimed.

regions.name: Vice City
regions.officialText: We're a long way from the '80s, but Vice City is still the sun and fun capital of America, the glamour, hustle, and greed of America captured in a single city.

regions.name: Leonida Keys
regions.officialText: Life in this tropical archipelago isn't flashy but it's easy, right on the doorstep of some of the most beautiful and dangerous waters in all of America.

regions.name: Grassrivers
regions.officialText: You never know what lies beneath the surface of this primordial expanse, the gators may be the most famous attraction, but there are far deadlier predators and weirder discoveries among the mangroves.

regions.name: Port Gellhorn
regions.officialText: Cheap motels, shut-down attractions, and empty strip malls won't bring the tourists.

regions.name: Ambrosia
regions.officialText: Rockstar's oil-and-sugar country: an interior area tied to the state's agricultural and industrial backroads.

regions.name: Mount Kalaga National Park
regions.officialText: A national landmark up against the state's northern border, Mount Kalaga offers prime hunting, fishing.

regions.name: Paradise Garage
regions.officialText: Ultimate Edition garage: weapon locker plus a secure place to deposit stolen goods to be fenced, storing the '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy.

regions.name: Vercetti Estate
regions.officialText: Source of the Ultimate Edition Morgan revolvers — a returning GTA landmark from the Vice City era.
